ssl_analysis.root_cause: Certificate SAN does not include support.hyperfocuszone.com

option_1.name: Update Existing Certificate (RECOMMENDED)
option_1.description: Add support.hyperfocuszone.com to existing certificate SAN
steps: Access current certificate provider (Google Trust Services)
Update certificate SAN to include support.hyperfocuszone.com
Re-issue certificate with updated SAN list

option_2.name: Separate Certificate for Support Subdomain
option_2.description: Generate dedicated SSL certificate for support.hyperfocuszone.com
steps: Request certificate from CA (Let's Encrypt or existing provider)
Install separate certificate for support subdomain
Update NGINX server block for support.hyperfocuszone.com

option_3.name: Wildcard Certificate Upgrade
steps: Verify automatic coverage for future subdomains

immediate_steps.details: Access Google Trust Services or certificate management panel
Include support subdomain in Subject Alternative Names
Backup existing SSL certificates and NGINX config
Replace certificate files with updated versions
Test SSL connection and verify certificate validity
